headword: {名物料理|めいぶつりょうり}
gloss: local specialty dish; famous regional cuisine

definitions.gloss: local specialty dish; famous regional cuisine
definitions.explanation: A dish that a particular region or restaurant is famous for, often closely associated with local ingredients and culinary traditions.

examples.japanese: {大阪|おおさか}の{名物料理|めいぶつりょうり}はたこ{焼|や}きだ。
examples.english: Osaka's famous local dish is takoyaki.

examples.japanese: {旅先|たびさき}では{必|かなら}ずその{土地|とち}の{名物料理|めいぶつりょうり}を{食|た}べるようにしている。
examples.english: When I travel, I always make sure to eat the local specialty dishes.

examples.japanese: このレストランの{名物料理|めいぶつりょうり}は{三十年|さんじゅうねん}{以上|いじょう}も{変|か}わらない{味|あじ}を{守|まも}り{続|つづ}けている。
examples.english: This restaurant's signature dish has maintained the same taste for over thirty years.

notes:
A compound of {名物|めいぶつ} (famous product; specialty) and {料理|りょうり} (cooking; cuisine). Japan has a rich culture of regional specialty foods, and trying {名物料理|めいぶつりょうり} is considered an essential part of travel. Nearly every prefecture and city has its own signature dishes, such as {博多|はかた}ラーメン in Fukuoka, {味噌|みそ}カツ in Nagoya, and {讃岐|さぬき}うどん in Kagawa.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {名物料理|めいぶつりょうり}を{味|あじ}わう: to savor a local specialty
- {名物料理|めいぶつりょうり}を{食|た}べ{歩|ある}く: to go around eating local specialties
- {地元|じもと}の{名物料理|めいぶつりょうり}: local specialty dish
- この{店|みせ}の{名物料理|めいぶつりょうり}: this restaurant's signature dish

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {郷土料理|きょうどりょうり}: regional cuisine — emphasizes traditional cooking methods and local ingredients passed down through generations
- {名物|めいぶつ}: famous product; specialty — broader term covering not just food but any product a place is known for
- {B級|びーきゅう}グルメ: B-class gourmet — affordable, casual local foods, often street food or fast food specialties
